mapper.select: SELECT cycle_id, cycle_code, cycle_name, cycle_type, start_date, end_date, status, create_time FROM cost_cycle ORDER BY cycle_code DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cost_cycle (cycle_code, cycle_name, cycle_type, start_date, end_date, status, create_time) VALUES (#{cycleCode}, #{cycleName}, #{cycleType}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE cost_cycle SET cycle_code = #{cycleCode}, cycle_name = #{cycleName}, cycle_type = #{cycleType}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, status = #{status} WHERE cycle_id = #{cycleId}
